article.story: YPSILANTI, Mich. -- — Da'Sean Nelson's 25 points helped Eastern Michigan defeat Miami (Ohio) 76-66 on Tuesday night. Nelson also added eight rebounds and four blocks for the Eagles (13-13, 6-7 Mid-American Conference). Jalen Terry scored 24 points while going 7 of 13 from the floor, including 3 for 6 from 3-point range, and 7 for 8 from the line and added nine rebounds and three steals. Jalin Billingsley went 6 of 10 from the field to finish with 12 points. The RedHawks (19-7, 10-3) were led in scoring by Eian Elmer, who finished with 19 points. Miami also got 11 points from Kam Craft. Eastern Michigan took the lead with 12:15 to go in the first half and did not relinquish it. The score was 35-23 at halftime, with Terry racking up 17 points. Nelson scored 18 points in the second half. Eastern Michigan's next game is Saturday against Northern Illinois on the road, and Miami hosts Kent State on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
